name: genter
description: Decision memory for your AI: it searches a folder of your notes and docs, current answer first, and marks what was replaced.
long_description:
Genter shows your AI what you decided, where it is written and when, and marks what was replaced since.

Pick a folder of notes, docs or code. Genter reads it again at every question, so the answer is what the files say now, with the file and lines it came from. When a document says at its top that a newer one replaced it, the newer one comes first and the old one shows its own notice, quoted.

It runs on this computer. It needs no account and no key, sends nothing anywhere, never changes your files, and keeps no copy of their text.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search the folder you chose and your notes, read again now: places with their file and lines, their dates, and a mark when a place says it was replaced.

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read places whole and now, by the ids search returned.

folder.title: Folder to search
folder.description: The folder of notes, docs or code your AI may search: one project, not your whole home folder. Genter only reads it.
